integrity: Analytic proof and a stand-alone finite verifier; no claim of independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for diagonal positive-definite quadratics, independent coordinate picks and centered independent finite-variance additive coordinate noise, fixed positive coordinate steps. Pareto variable is the sharp second-moment transient factor, not pathwise or finite-horizon loss.
title: An exact noise–rate Pareto frontier for randomized coordinate descent
